name: Key Bind
description: Enables the ability when the player presses a key. What exactly happens on a key press depends on the behaviour.

fields.description: The key that is used for the ability. By default this is the ability key matching the ability's slot in the ability bar.

How the ability reacts to the key. 'activation' turns it on for a set time after a single press, 'toggle' switches it on and off with each press, and 'held' keeps it on for as long as the key is held down.

Time the player has to wait before the ability can be used again. For 'activation' the cooldown starts right when the key is pressed, for 'toggle' and 'held' it starts once the ability turns off. 0 means no cooldown.

Depends on the behaviour. For 'activation' it's how long the ability stays on after pressing the key (at least 1 tick). For 'toggle' and 'held' it's the maximum time the ability can stay on before it turns off by itself, 0 means there is no limit.

name: Conditional
description: Enables the ability for as long as the given conditions are fulfilled. You can also skip the handler object and just put the condition(s) straight into the 'enabling' field, it does the same thing.

fields.description: The condition(s) that need to be fulfilled for the ability to be enabled.
